one_line: Open on a problem line over the product, show each benefit as its own shot, end on one comment word.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 wide kitchen, a mother holding a baby beside a man, a large OZY box on the floor; at 2 s she opens it. Voiceover (transcript): 'אין מצב שאני אמא יחידה שהבית שלה הפך למחסן'. Subtitles: 'אין מצב'.
q1_hook.why: A shared complaint ('I can't be the only mother') names the problem in one line and invites 'me too' (H1, K6). The box fills the frame, so the product is on screen from 0:00 and handled by 2 s (S1). Voice and text start together (H6). What the product gives only arrives at 0:11 (H2).

beats.what: Wide kitchen, parents and baby, big OZY box; 'אין מצב'
beats.why: A complaint and the product in the same frame.

beats.what: Mother opens the box, pulls out the tray, toy bar and frame; 'כל שלב בהתפתחות', 'והחלטתי שדי'
beats.why: Unboxing gives movement while the problem is spoken.

beats.what: Baby eating in the assembled high chair; 'אני לא צריכה מיליון דברים'
beats.why: The product appears in use as the answer to the problem.

beats.what: Toddler on the chair as a learning tower at the counter; 'הוא דוגמה מצוינת'
beats.why: Second use shown before it is named.

beats.what: '3 ב-1' over the toy bar, then newborn seat, high chair, learning tower, one per second
beats.why: A numbered list: three modes, each shown as it is named.

beats.what: Chair folded against a wall and a fridge; 'ובונוס', 'הוא מתקפל בקלות'
beats.why: Answers the clutter worry with a visible fold.

beats.what: Baby eating from a plate; 'תגיבי', 'ואשלח לך לינק'; toddler at the counter
beats.why: One comment word asked right after the last proof.

beats.what: Mother with a baby points at the box in the same kitchen
beats.why: Echoes the opening frame, a soft loop.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Comment-word ask: 'תגיבי' and 'ואשלח לך לינק' (0:25 to 0:26), repeated in the caption. No question. The opening 'me too' line invites relating but does not ask.
q2_flow.why: The problem line sets an answer the viewer waits for (H5). A new shot about every 1.2 s, each on the word being said, keeps new information constant (R3, E2). The three modes arrive as a quick list, and the last shot echoes the first (R4).

q3_cta.what: Said at about 0:23 (transcript): 'ואם בא לך לשמוע על כל הפיצ'רים שיש בו, תגיבי כיסא'. Subtitles 'תגיבי' (0:25), 'ואשלח לך לינק' (0:26). Caption: 'תגיבי “כיסא” ואשלח לך לינק עם כל הפרטים.'
q3_cta.why: One action, said and shown after the proof, in the last 5 s, and repeated in the caption (C1, C6). The word delivers something real (a link with details), so it is not bait (C3, C2). The reason to comment is vague, with no price or offer.

q4_shown.what: The OZY box and unboxing 0:00 to 0:07 (tray, toy bar, frame); a baby eating in the high chair 0:08; a toddler on the learning tower 0:11 and 0:18; a POV of the newborn seat 0:15; the chair folded 0:19 to 0:22. No price.
q4_shown.why: Each claim (3 in 1, folds, learning tower) is shown by a real child using that mode, in the order the voice says it (S1, K5). The parent's own problem and a brand tag make it a first-hand vouch, though the lines read as brand copy (S6).

q5_edit.what: About 24 shots in 28 s (average 1.2 s), straight cuts, each on a word or phrase; no speed changes seen. Subtitles in 1 to 3 word chunks, key word bold. A '3 ב-1' graphic at 0:14. Ends on a wide kitchen shot.
q5_edit.why: Constant cuts, each on a new word, keep information flowing (R3), but 1.2 s is faster than the 2 to 5 s the research suggests (E2). Short bold chunks do not fight the picture (T2, E4). It stops on the mirrored last shot with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: One baby chair that does three jobs as the answer to a home full of baby gear: fewer, smarter items for a parent facing a purchase at every stage.
q6_topic.why: It starts from a real parent feeling, 'every stage means another thing to buy', and answers with something practical (K6). The use is stated modestly and shown, not promised (K4). The 'newborn to 5' span in the caption ties it to stages parents plan for.

q7_filmed.what: Mostly static phone shots in a bright kitchen with window daylight: eye level and low angle at the box, a top-down POV of the newborn seat on a rug, close top-down on a plate, a wide opener. Several rooms. Mother, father, baby, toddler.
q7_filmed.why: Static, well-lit shots keep the product readable (F7, F4), and the top-down POV is how a parent sees it (F5). Several rooms, a baby and a toddler make it hard to copy solo without a child.

q8_text.on_screen: Small white bold sans-serif subtitles, centred at about half the frame height, 1 to 3 words per chunk, key word bold: 'אין מצב' (0:00), 'שהבית שלה הפך למחסן' (0:02), 'מיליון דברים' (0:08), '3 ב-1' graphic (0:14), 'גם כיסא ניובורן' (0:15), 'הוא מתקפל בקלות' (0:20), 'תגיבי' (0:25), 'ואשלח לך לינק' (0:26).
q8_text.caption: 'בתור אמא, חשוב לי למצוא מוצרים שנשארים לאורך זמן' ... Long: a parent need, the product name, three check-mark bullets, 'מגיל לידה ועד גיל 5', the comment-word CTA, 'בשיתוף @babystarisrael x @anex_baby', five hashtags.
q8_text.why: Short keyword chunks above the bottom 35% work muted and clear of the buttons (T1, T2, T4). The caption's bullets name what parents search (ניובורן, כיסא אוכל, מגדל למידה), but all five hashtags are generic (T7). 'בשיתוף' sits below the first lines (T8, S7).

weak_points: Voiceover that reads as brand copy; the 3-in-1 value only at 0:11; a vague reason to comment and no price; cuts every 1.2 s; many rooms and a baby and toddler that Yarin cannot copy.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with the closed book on a table, a hand opens it, one benefit per shot with 1 to 3 word captions, end on one comment word. No child needed.
not_verified: The word 'כיסא' is in the transcript and the caption but not in the sampled subtitle frames (0:25 'תגיבי', 0:26 'ואשלח לך לינק'), so its on-screen timing is unconfirmed. Price; whether the unboxing is staged; whose voice. The paid-partnership label is 1 per media info, not visible in the frames. Correction: the product's parts are handled from about 0:03 and the assembled seat first appears at 0:08.
